name: comp-380
title: Theme Switcher Dropdown
description: A square icon button shows the current appearance and opens a short menu with Light, Dark and System options. Picking one swaps the button's sun or moon icon.
use: Users need to pick light, dark or system appearance from a compact control.
avoid: It only changes its own icon here; no page theme is actually applied without extra wiring.
a11y: The trigger has an aria-label and rows are menu items; the current theme shows only as an icon, not a checked state. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark settings card pairs 'Appearance' and a grey subtitle with a square outlined icon button at the right, holding a small sun. Clicking opens a compact dark menu directly below with sun, moon and monitor icons beside Light, Dark and System.
behaves: Clicking the icon opens the menu; hovering highlights a row, and choosing a theme closes the menu and swaps the trigger icon between sun and moon. Nothing else on the page changes.
customise: The three option labels, icons and the starting 'system' value are in the file; hooking a real theme provider means editing the click handlers.
weight: light: One tiny menu and three icons; no animation loop.
